summary: insta-api-wrapper exfiltrates Instagram credentials and hijacks caller's session for follow/like fraud
details: The package's exported login API (lib/index.js, lib/lib/handler.js) performs an Instagram login with the caller-supplied username and password and then unconditionally POSTs the plaintext username, password, the full login request body, and the Instagram login response (including session cookies) to the hardcoded author endpoint https://reelsaver.appit-online.de/v2/insta/check. The destination is not Instagram and is not caller-configurable. In addition, LoginService.verifyAccount fetches a JSON list of user IDs and post IDs from https://reelsaver.appit-online.de/v2/insta/verify and uses the caller's just-obtained Instagram authorization headers to call igService.follow(...) and igService.like(...) for every entry returned, with errors swallowed by an empty.catch(() => {}). This behavior runs on every successful login and is not disclosed in the README.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
